schema.assumptions: build used for the numbers: designer preset (level, equipment, talents, wine), focus assumption, desiredHp
schema.stats: hpMax, mpMax, staminaMax, attack, defense, critRate (1/10000), critMultiplier (1/10000 added to 1.3), dmgDef (1/10000), dmgAddition, tenacity, trueDamageRatio, gourdCharges, contributions [{from, attr, value}]
schema.stamina: max, regenPerSec, regenBlockedDuringCostWindows (regen paused inside every staminaCost window), sprintPerSec, depletion
schema.dodge: chain [{skill, clips {F,B,L,R}, staminaCost, regenBlocked, iframe {start,end,buff}, timeline}], perfect {...}
schema.lightCombo: [{step, skill, clip, staminaCost, minStaminaToStart, damage {effectId: damage effect (see tiger.json effects)}, focusGain [{effect,value}], superArmor windows, timeline (montage summary incl. hits with effect ids, comboWindows with whitelist, dodgeWindows, comboKeyCache)}]
schema.sprintLight: same shape as a lightCombo entry
schema.heavy: {levels [{level, skill, clip, chargeStartSkill, chargeStartClip, chargeStartCost, staminaCost, damage, superArmor, timeline}], loopClip, loopStaminaCost (per loop pass), loopLength, charge {focusGainPerSec, focusGainStartsAfter, rule, consumesAllFocus, damageReductionWhileCharging}}
schema.focus: {activeConfig, configs {id: [{level, threshold, decayPerSec, protectTime (-1 never decays), normalMax}]}, perfectDodgeGain}
schema.gourd: {charges, wine, healPctOfHpMax, healFlat, clip, healTime s, chargeSpentTime s, timeline}
schema.hitReactions: rules mapping tiger hits to player reactions
schema.reboundClips: {skillId: clip played when the attack hits a BounceAttack target (tiger stone form)}

meta.units: meters, seconds, degrees; times are montage-time seconds

assumptions.preset: RoleDataConfigDesc group 31 '黄风庙后期' (designer test build for late chapter 2)
assumptions.focusTalents: the preset lists no 棍势二/三/四段 (100501/100503/100505, cost 0 talent points); focus.activeConfig uses config 3 (all three) so heavy levels 0-4 are reachable; see combat.md

depletion.note: at 0 stamina: buff 129 (1.5 s, regen x0) adds buff 130 for 3000 ms (SimpleState StaminaDepleted); casting any skill while depleted removes 129

stamina.costFormula: cost = base x StaminaCostMultiper(1); actions need current stamina >= minStaminaToStart

dodge.chainNote: FUStRollSkillDesc: consecutive dodges advance 10301 -> 10302 -> 10303 -> 10301; directional clips only while locked on

perfect.trigger: an enemy hit sweep or attackWarning shape overlaps the player's PreciseDodge capsule (r 0.9 m, half 1.6 m) -> window = 0.03 s refreshed every overlapping frame; dodge pressed while window > 0 -> perfect dodge (no stamina cost) instead of a roll

charge.rule: hold heavy: start clip = xuli_start_<current focus level>; from 0.7 s into the start stage buff 246 adds 5.5 focus every 0.1 s (reason ByChargeSkill, capped at the first normalMax level); each focus level reached = charge level +1; release plays xuli_attack_<charge level>

hitReactions.superArmor: player montage superArmor windows: incoming effect.armorBreak (monster 打断 values) is subtracted from the window value; > 0 left -> no reaction
